newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, interbank rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, interbank rates steady.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was steady against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly unchanged in moderate trade, dealers in Saudi Arabia said.
They said activity focused on swaps amid a return of liquidity to the market.
"Activity centered on swaps after liquidity returned to the market," one said.
The spot Saudi riyal was put at 3.7505/07 to the dollar.
One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three-months at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year at 6-3/8, 1/4 percent.
